The .geojson files in this folder are data of openAIP, https://www.openaip.net,
recorded on 2026-11-19 and 2026-11-22 from
https://storage.openaip.net/openaip-system-exports/
and licensed under the Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 4.0
International License, https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc/4.0/.
They are not covered by the licence of the code around them.

de_asp.geojson and at_asp.geojson are the airspace exports for Germany and
Austria, cut down to the features that reach into the northern Alps around
Munich, Innsbruck and Salzburg and have no more than 250 (Germany) or 110
(Austria) corners. Each feature kept is as openAIP published it, with one
exception: the fields "createdBy" and "updatedBy", which hold the user
identifiers of openAIP's contributors, are removed. The adapter does not
read them, and this repository holds no personal data.

ch_asp.geojson, it_asp.geojson, si_asp.geojson, hr_asp.geojson,
hu_asp.geojson and sk_asp.geojson are the airspace exports for Switzerland,
Italy, Slovenia, Croatia, Hungary and Slovakia of the same day, cut down to
the features that reach into the first region's box and have no more than
60 corners, with the same two fields removed.

fr_asp.geojson and ba_asp.geojson are the airspace exports for France and
for Bosnia and Herzegovina of 2026-11-22, with the same two fields removed.
France's is cut down to the features that reach into the Alps from Grenoble
to Annecy and Chamonix and have no more than 20 corners; Bosnia's to those
that reach into the box of the three Alpine regions and have no more than
60 corners.

All of them are samples. They are not the airspace of any area.

To record them again: fetch the files from the address above. Of
de_asp.geojson and at_asp.geojson keep the features whose bounding box
touches 47.2..48.5 N, 10.9..13.2 E (Germany) or 47.0..47.95 N,
10.9..13.2 E (Austria), within the corner limits; of the six others those
whose bounding box touches 46.3..48.5 N, 9.4..17.2 E and that have no more
than 60 corners; of fr_asp.geojson those whose bounding box touches
45.0..46.1 N, 5.6..7.1 E and that have no more than 20 corners; of
ba_asp.geojson those whose bounding box touches 43.5..48.5 N, 5.0..17.2 E
and that have no more than 60 corners; all in the order of the file. Then run the tests with
VENTI_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 and review what changed.

at_asp_damaged.geojson is not openAIP's data as published: it is eight
features of at_asp.geojson, seven of them deliberately broken, to test how
the adapter reports what it cannot read. The test that uses it says how
each is broken.

openAIP's data is not certified and must not be used for navigation.
